issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: HuntMonitor
products.tagline: Watch today's hunt live: points, speed, rank moves
products.summaryZh: 今日狩猎直播：积分、速度、排名变动
products.descriptionZh: HuntMonitor 是今日 Product Hunt 竞赛的实时仪表板。可按分数、评论、投票速度或猎人排序。保持一个标签页打开，查看某个发布是在攀升还是下滑。打开任意一行，查看当天的分数图表。实时更新，每 15 分钟生成快照。
products.description: HuntMonitor is a live dashboard for today's Product Hunt race. Sort by points, comments, upvote speed, or hunter. Keep one tab open to see if a launch is climbing or slipping. Open any row for the day's points chart. Updates live, snapshots every 15 minutes.

products.name: Remindly
products.tagline: Notes that remind you, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and web
products.summaryZh: 在 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和网页上提醒你的备忘录
products.descriptionZh: Remindly 是一款快速的笔记应用，任何笔记都可以附带提醒：一次性、重复、全天或到达某地时。可通过打字、语音、扫描或网页剪藏来记录。在 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和网页端同步。可导入你的 Evernote 资料库。
products.description: Remindly is a fast notes app where any note can carry a reminder: one-time, repeating, all-day, or when you arrive somewhere. Capture by typing, voice, scan, or the web clipper. Syncs across iPhone, iPad, Mac and web. Imports your Evernote library.

products.name: Perit Marketplace
products.tagline: Sell your data and RL tasks to frontier AI labs
products.summaryZh: 将你的数据和强化学习任务出售给前沿人工智能实验室
products.descriptionZh: Perit Marketplace 将你的数据和专业知识转化为前沿 AI 实验室的训练工作。两种参与方式：提交你拥有的数据（音频、视频、代码、文档、CAD 等；目前已列出 29 个数据集），或使用我们的虚拟机和模型额度在我们的平台上构建 RL 任务和基准测试。我们向实验室推介这些内容，获批的专家每周可扩展到数百个任务。由 Perit（YC F26）打造，目前 4.5 个月内营收已超过 1100 万美元。
products.description: Perit Marketplace turns your data and expertise into training work for frontier AI labs. Two ways in: submit data you own (audio, video, code, docs, CAD and more; 29 datasets listed so far), or build RL tasks and benchmarks on our platform using our VMs and model credits. We pitch them to labs, and approved experts scale to hundreds of tasks a week. Built by Perit (YC F26), now past $11M in revenue in 4.5 months.

products.name: Polylane for Security
products.tagline: Catch exploitable vulnerabilities before they ship
products.summaryZh: 在发布前捕获可利用的漏洞
products.descriptionZh: Polylane 审查即将进入生产环境的拉取请求，查找可利用的安全漏洞。发现结果会追踪攻击者控制的输入至存在漏洞的代码行，并附上证据和建议修复方案。安全候选会被排除并给出原因。每日依赖扫描可发现已知 CVE，优先处理最严重的漏洞，并在活跃且已部署的仓库上发起修复拉取请求。
products.description: Polylane reviews production-bound pull requests for exploitable security flaws. Findings trace attacker-controlled input to the vulnerable line, with the evidence and suggested fix. Safe candidates are ruled out with a reason. Daily dependency scans find known CVEs, prioritise the most severe and open fix pull requests on active, deployed repositories.

products.name: ByteAsk Cloud Agents
products.tagline: Find the fix in big codebases. Ship it from Slack.
products.summaryZh: 在大型代码库中定位修复。从 Slack 发布。
products.descriptionZh: ByteAsk 为 Claude Code 和 Codex 提供整个仓库的索引，让它们从正确的文件开始。其 Cloud Agent 从 Slack、Jira 或浏览器接收 bug，在沙箱中构建和测试，并打开草稿 PR。注册即获 $50 额度，无需信用卡。
products.description: ByteAsk gives Claude Code and Codex an index of your whole repo, so they start in the right file. Its Cloud Agent takes bugs from Slack, Jira or the browser, builds and tests in a sandbox, and opens a draft PR. Start with $50 of credit, no card.

products.name: GotEmail
products.tagline: Fast, native and smart email for Mac and iPhone
products.summaryZh: 为Mac和iPhone打造的快速、原生且智能的电子邮件体验
products.descriptionZh: GotEmail 是一款适用于 Mac 和 iPhone 的原生邮件应用。Gmail、Outlook、iCloud、Yahoo 及任何 IMAP 账户汇聚于一个快速收件箱，智能收件箱可筛选出重要邮件，并提供 AI 草稿、摘要以及了解你邮件的助手、一键登录验证码、稍后处理、定时发送、撤销发送、已读回执、标签和智能文件夹。无广告，无自有账户：你的邮件直接在设备与邮件服务商之间传输。一份许可涵盖所有 Mac 和 iPhone 应用。
products.description: GotEmail is a native mail app for Mac and iPhone. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo and any IMAP account in one fast inbox, with a Smart Inbox that sorts out what matters, AI drafts, summaries and an assistant that knows your mail, one-click sign-in codes, snooze, send later, undo send, read receipts, labels and smart folders. No ads, no account of ours: your mail goes straight between your device and your provider. One license covers every Mac and the iPhone app.

products.name: Skepia
products.tagline: Boost your creativity with daily mental fitness
products.summaryZh: 通过每日脑力锻炼提升创造力
products.descriptionZh: Skepia 是一款以设计为先的移动应用，专注于心理健身与创造性思维。体验 100 多个基于 SCAMPER 和横向思维等技巧的挑战，并获得个性化反馈，揭示你的创造力画像。既然创意需要敏锐的头脑，那就享受重新构想的大脑训练：精心设计的谜题，难度足以让你思考，趣味性足以养成日常习惯。
products.description: Skepia is a design-first mobile app for mental fitness and creative thinking. Take 100+ challenges built on techniques like SCAMPER and lateral thinking, with personalized feedback that reveals your creative profile. And since ideas need a sharp mind, enjoy brain training, reimagined: beautifully crafted puzzles, hard enough to make you think and fun enough to build a daily habit.

products.name: iOS Push Notification Mockup
products.tagline: Free iPhone Lock Screen mockup with iOS 27 Liquid Glass
products.summaryZh: 免费 iPhone 锁屏样机，搭载 iOS 27 液态玻璃
products.descriptionZh: 几秒钟即可制作逼真的 iPhone 锁屏，并加入你自己的推送通知。最多可写三条通知，选择真实的应用图标或上传自己的图标，并添加聊天头像。选择墙纸以及 Liquid Glass 或纯色时钟。下载全分辨率 PNG，可选择带或不带 iPhone 边框，包括 iPhone Duo App Store 尺寸。免费、无需注册、无水印，你的图片绝不会离开浏览器。
products.description: Make a realistic iPhone Lock Screen with your own Push Notifications in seconds. Write up to three notifications, pick a real app icon or upload your own, and add a chat avatar. Choose the wallpaper and a Liquid Glass or solid clock. Download a full-resolution PNG, with or without the iPhone frame, including iPhone Duo App Store sizes. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, and your images never leave your browser.

products.name: Transformer.gg
products.tagline: The agentic influencer marketplace
products.summaryZh: 代理型网红市场
products.descriptionZh: 代理式网红市场。真实创作者，按确认发布的帖子付费。可从仪表盘或你的代理运行。品牌发送付费邀约，创作者在X上发布，追踪链接归因每一次点击和销售。
products.description: The agentic influencer marketplace. Real creators, paid on confirmed posts. Run it from the dashboard or from your agent. Brands send paid offers, creators post on X, and tracked links attribute every click and sale.

products.name: ProMax Display
products.tagline: Full screen that uses your MacBook's whole display
products.summaryZh: 全屏使用MacBook的整个显示屏
products.descriptionZh: 在全屏模式下，macOS 会让刘海旁边的区域保持黑色。ProMax Display 将其恢复：14 英寸 MacBook Pro 从 14.06 英寸屏幕变为完整的 14.2 英寸。还提供刘海后方内容的“后视镜”视图，以及用于菜单栏和 Dock 的触控板手势。适用于带刘海或灵动岛的 MacBook。
products.description: In full screen, macOS leaves the strip beside the notch black. ProMax Display gives it back: a 14" MacBook Pro goes from a 14.06" screen to the full 14.2". With a rear-view mirror for what's behind the notch, and trackpad gestures for the menu bar and Dock. For MacBooks with a notch or Dynamic Island.

products.name: CSS Animation Gallery
products.tagline: 100+ CSS animations you can tune and copy in one click
products.summaryZh: 100 多个 CSS 动画，一键调整并复制
products.descriptionZh: 预览100多种CSS动画，以及3D翻转卡片、立方体、轮播、滑块和悬停效果。在实时元素上调整速度、缓动和循环次数，一键复制含@keyframes的HTML和CSS。每个动画均为纯CSS，无需库，可轻松融入任何网站或框架。免费，无需注册。
products.description: Preview 100+ CSS animations plus 3D flip cards, cubes, carousels, sliders and hover effects. Change the speed, easing and loop count on a live element, then copy the HTML and CSS with @keyframes in one click. Every animation is plain CSS with no libraries, so it drops into any site or framework. Free, no sign-up.

products.name: Wanderjet
products.tagline: Turn focus sessions into flights you take with others
products.summaryZh: 将专注时段变成与他人一同踏上的飞行旅程
products.descriptionZh: 一款iPhone专注计时器，每次专注都是一段飞行。选择一个真实城市，工作到落地为止。在3D客舱中选座，每到一个国家收集一枚护照印章，或搭乘每小时出发的集体航班，与大家一同落地。
products.description: A focus timer for iPhone where every session is a flight. Pick a real city and work until you land. Choose your seat in a 3D cabin, collect a passport stamp for each country, or board the group flight that leaves every hour and land with everyone else.

products.name: DeclineKit
products.tagline: Open-source failed payment recovery for Stripe
products.summaryZh: 面向 Stripe 的开源失败付款恢复工具
products.descriptionZh: 当 Stripe 订阅续费被拒时，DeclineKit 会以你的名义向客户发送邮件，其中包含指向 Stripe 托管卡片表单的链接，并在客户添加新卡后立即重试发票。开源：可免费自托管，或使用托管的 Cloud。
products.description: When a Stripe subscription renewal is declined, DeclineKit emails your customer in your name with a link to a Stripe-hosted card form, then retries the invoice the moment they add a new card. Open source: self-host it free, or use the hosted Cloud.

products.name: Book2Life
products.tagline: The reading app built to get you to the last page
products.summaryZh: 这款阅读应用旨在助你读到最后。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数书开了头，却少有读完的。Book2Life 是一款为解决这一问题而生的电子书阅读器：语音随读，逐词高亮；每个人物都有面孔，每个地点都有画面；Ask the Book 只根据你读过的页面作答。数千本免费经典，也可导入你自己的 EPUB。支持 iPhone、iPad、Mac、Android 和网页端。无需注册，即可在浏览器中试用。
products.description: Most books get started. Fewer get finished. Book2Life is an ebook reader built to fix that: a voice reads along as each word lights up, every character gets a face and every place a picture, and Ask the Book answers only from pages you’ve read. Thousands of free classics, or bring your own EPUBs. On iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and the web. Try it in your browser with no sign-up.

products.name: Chiban
products.tagline: Open-source permitting software for small US towns
products.summaryZh: 面向美国小城镇的开源许可软件
products.descriptionZh: Chiban 是面向美国小城镇的开源（AGPL-3.0）土地使用与许可软件。建筑与贸易许可可在柜台和线上办理，检查可在手机上完成，规划与分区委员会案件会通知附近业主，法规执行也一并纳入，全部按地块归档。每项截止日期都会显示其依据的州规则。工作人员可自行编辑表单和费用。随时可免费获取完整导出。可使用 Docker Compose 自托管，或选择托管服务。
products.description: Chiban is open-source (AGPL-3.0) land-use and permitting software for small US towns. Building and trade permits at the counter and online, inspections on a phone, planning and zoning board cases with notices to nearby owners, and code enforcement, all filed under the parcel. Each deadline shows the state rule it runs on. Staff edit forms and fees themselves. A complete export is free at any time. Self-host with Docker Compose, or have it hosted.

products.name: Catchline
products.tagline: Bar path and joint angles on your lift video, on-device
products.summaryZh: 在你的举重视频中，杠铃轨迹和关节角度，设备端呈现
products.descriptionZh: 添加你的举重视频，即可在真实画面上看到标出的杠铃轨迹、身体线条和关节角度。适用于抓举、挺举、深蹲、硬拉、引体向上和双力臂。逐帧查看，自行绘制线条，并导出叠加内容已烧录进画面的视频。追踪在 iPhone 上运行：视频不会离开设备，也绝不会用于训练。每周可免费处理 3 个视频，Pro 解锁无限次。
products.description: Add a video of your lift and get it back with the bar path, body lines and joint angles drawn on the real footage. Works for snatch, clean and jerk, squat, deadlift, pull-ups and muscle-ups. Step frame by frame, draw your own lines, and export a video with the overlays burned in. Tracking runs on your iPhone: your video never leaves it and is never used for training. Free for 3 videos a week, Pro unlocks unlimited.

products.name: zSign
products.tagline: Send a PDF from a Chrome tab without paying per seat
products.summaryZh: 从Chrome标签页发送PDF，无需按席位付费
products.descriptionZh: zSign 让你无需按席位付费或订阅即可签署协议。信封起价 27 美元 50 个，团队可免费添加，并可从仪表板、Chrome 标签页、Zapier 或你的 AI 助手发送。通过邮箱验证后，可免费获得 3 个信封。
products.description: zSign gets your agreements signed without per-seat pricing or a subscription. Buy envelopes from $27 for 50, add your team for free, and send from the dashboard, a Chrome tab, Zapier or your AI assistant. Start with 3 free envelopes after email verification.

products.name: Xeek Sites
products.tagline: Design websites with AI, then refine every detail
products.summaryZh: 用AI设计网站，然后完善每一个细节
products.descriptionZh: 描述你想要的网站，Xeek Sites 会为你起草，随时可供你修改和发布。
products.description: Describe the website you want and Xeek Sites drafts it, ready for you to change and publish.

products.name: Folio Ledger
products.tagline: Track expenses. Review reports. Export your records.
products.summaryZh: 记录支出。查看报告。导出记录。
products.descriptionZh: Folio Ledger 是一款面向个人和小型企业的支出跟踪应用。在一个便捷的仪表板中记录收入和支出、整理交易、监控支出并查看财务报告。使用 CSV、PDF 和 Excel 报告功能导出记录。用 Folio Ledger 让财务记录井然有序。
products.description: Folio Ledger is an expense-tracking app for individuals and small businesses. Record income and expenses, organise transactions, monitor spending, and review financial reports in one convenient dashboard. Export your records using CSV, PDF and Excel reporting features. Keep your financial records organised with Folio Ledger.

products.name: FreshClock: Fridge & Pantry
products.tagline: Eat it before it spoils, and see what you save
products.summaryZh: 在它变质前吃掉，看看你能节省什么
products.descriptionZh: FreshClock 会在食物变质前提示该吃什么，并计算你节省的开支。几秒钟即可添加采购物品：点选常见食物、扫描条形码或拍摄收据。FreshClock 会为冰箱、冷冻室和食品储藏室填入典型保质期，然后按需优先食用的顺序排列所有物品。FreshClock Plus（可选订阅）：读取收据并每天获取食谱建议，回顾每个月的情况，并与家庭成员共享一个食品储藏室和购物清单。
products.description: FreshClock shows what to eat before it spoils, and counts the money you save. Add a grocery run in seconds: tap common foods, scan a barcode, or snap your receipt. FreshClock fills in typical expiry dates for the fridge, freezer and pantry, then sorts everything by what needs eating first. FreshClock Plus (optional subscription): read receipts and get recipe ideas every day, look back at every month, and share one pantry and grocery list with your household.
